item.title: After ditching Mamata Banerjee, Yusuf Pathan gets a gift from Gujarat govt
item.description: The state government approved the allotment of a disputed 978 sqm plot in Vadodara to Yusuf Pathan. The allotment includes 500 sqm for residential use and 478 sqm at a reduced rate. This decision follows a long-standing dispute over the plot, which began in 2012 with Pathan's initial request. The municipal commissioner noted that final details must still undergo approval by the VMC’s standing committee.
item.dc:creator: PRASHANT RUPERA

item.title: Who is Ben Treloar? Australian umpire set to officiate in Ranji Trophy
item.description: Australian umpire Ben Treloar will officiate in two Ranji Trophy matches in India, while Indian umpire Parashar Joshi will travel to Australia to officiate in two Sheffield Shield matches and one One Day Cup game as part of the CA-BCCI Umpire Exchange Program.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: 3 killed in Manipur, protesters take bodies of 2 to CM’s house
item.description: Three Meitei villagers were killed in an ambush by suspected militants on the Imphal East-Kangpokpi border. The incident occurred after an alleged breach of the Suspension of Operations agreement by an armed Kuki group. Protesters carried the bodies to the chief minister's residence to demand justice. The chief minister convened a meeting to review security and directed increased deployment in vulnerable areas.
item.dc:creator: PRABIN KALITA

item.title: After Dario Amodei’s donation, Elon Musk makes a promise to every kid in America
item.description: Elon Musk announced plans to give a SpaceX share to every American child next year. This initiative aims to distribute wealth and follow Anthropic's recent donation plans. Musk highlighted the importance of directly benefiting the public through share distribution. His wealth, estimated at $904 billion, will allow this significant donation to approximately 72 million children.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Taxman uses chats, Excel sheets to dispute property sale value; ITAT quashes addition
item.description: The dispute concerned a man and his wife, who jointly owned a property in Delhi before selling it.The Income Tax Department alleged that the buyers had paid an additional amount in cash beyond the sale consideration documented in the registered conveyance deed. The assessing officer calculated the total transaction value at around Rs 3.30 crore, whereas the registered sale deed recorded a consideration of Rs 1.60 crore.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Dussehra messages, greetings, wishes and quotes for 2026
item.description: Dussehra, occurring on October 20, 2026, celebrates the triumph of good over evil. This vibrant festival features heartfelt prayers, joyful family reunions, and the dramatic burning of effigies. It serves as a time for reconciliation, encouraging individuals to leave past grievances behind while embracing fresh starts. Messages of goodwill are shared, fostering positivity and strengthening connections, reminding everyone to embody love and bravery in everyday life.
item.dc:creator: TRENDING DESK

item.title: India and Australia hold joint wargames as China becomes more assertive in the Indo-Pacific
item.description: India and Australia have begun their joint army exercise AUSTRAHIND in Thiruvananthapuram from October 19 to November 1. About 120 personnel from both nations are participating with a focus on improving maritime security and interoperability. Troops will engage in joint planning, tactical drills, and combat training under a United Nations mandate. There is an emphasis on stronger cooperation between the two countries' defense industries and military forces.
item.dc:creator: DHRUV YADAV

item.title: In this village, Ravan is killed, not burned
item.description: In Ropa village, Dussehra is marked by a unique tradition of symbolically slaying Ravan instead of burning his effigy. A permanent 10-foot statue of Ravan has been repainted annually for about a century. Villagers gather to enact scenes from the Ramayana, culminating in the symbolic killing of Ravan. This practice reflects local respect for Ravan as a scholar rather than merely a villain.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Nike paid $35 for Swoosh logo, then gifted designer stock and gold ring
item.description: In 1971, Nike co-founder Phil Knight hired college student Carolyn Davidson to design the company’s iconic Swoosh logo for $35. Twelve years later, Davidson received a gold ring shaped like the Swoosh and 500 shares of Nike stock. Her design became one of the world’s most recognisable brand symbols, marking a lasting contribution to Nike’s identity.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Ohio couple spent $30,000 on friend's home; court revives eviction bid
item.description: An Ohio couple who moved into a friend's house in 2020 and spent $30,000 renovating its kitchen have lost their claim to purchase the property for $215,000. On Wednesday, an appeals court ruled that the renovations did not establish a binding purchase agreement. However, the couple may still receive compensation for the improvements, while the homeowners can pursue eviction proceedings.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: US govt bans DeepSeek that wiped over $1 trillion from Wall Street in less than 2 hrs
item.description: The US Department of Homeland Security has issued an order to ban all products and services of DeepSeek. Concerns have been raised regarding the potential transfer of sensitive data to the People's Republic of China. This decision follows previous actions by multiple US agencies against DeepSeek technology. The Federal Communications Commission is set to expand bans on testing by Chinese labs.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Engineer quits after 4 months, now grows organic for 50 customers
item.description: Jobandeep Singh embraced his roots after earning a mechanical engineering degree, opting to return to his village for a life in farming. By cultivating organic crops on four acres and selling directly to around 50 customers, he showcases a unique farming approach that incorporates crop diversity and livestock. This sustainable model not only satisfies family needs but also creates employment, exemplifying an unconventional path for agricultural success in Punjab.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Entourage star ditches Hollywood for 46-acre Texas ranch life
item.description: Actor Adrian Grenier, known for Entourage and The Devil Wears Prada, moved to Texas in 2020 and settled on a 46-acre ranch with his wife, Jordan, and their two children. Embracing a slower lifestyle, he has focused on sustainability, solar power, farming and beekeeping, turning the property into a family retreat rooted in environmental responsibility.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Ex-NFL star Shawne Merriman ordered to pay $4M wrongful death case
item.description: Former NFL linebacker Shawne Merriman has been ordered to pay $4 million to the family of Kimberly Fattorini, a Playboy employee who died of an accidental overdose in 2017. A jury found Merriman and three other defendants liable in 2025. Fattorini’s parents had alleged drugging and sexual assault, claims Merriman denied as baseless.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Captured at 19, Indian sailor survives 43 months with Somali pirates
item.description: Aman Kumar Sharma's journey began in 2010 when he joined the merchant navy, only to face an unimaginable nightmare at the hands of Somali pirates. His 43-month ordeal included witnessing horrific violence and losing a dear friend. After escaping captivity in June 2014, he returned to India and faced the psychological scars of his experience.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: 'Not an active captain': Rapido on shooter linked to Tiger Shroff firing
item.description: Three individuals were arrested in connection with a shooting attack on actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai. Shroff was not harmed, but his driver and a bystander sustained injuries during the incident. One of the suspects had previously worked as a bike-taxi rider and reportedly surveilled Shroff's residence. The police apprehended the suspects as they attempted to escape to Delhi.
item.dc:creator: HADI KHAN

item.title: ‘Give Sooryavanshi harsh truth’: Ex-cricketer explains Gambhir, management’s approach
item.description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, a talented 15-year-old cricketer, is still waiting for his big break in the Indian senior team. Despite his impressive glimpses, established players like Sanju Samson and Abhishek Sharma keep taking the spots. Former spinner Murali Kartik believes in the current squad and encourages Sooryavanshi to keep working hard for when his chance finally comes.
item.dc:creator: PRANAV SHUKLA

item.dc:creator: TRISHA MAHAJAN

item.title: Extortion is passe, Lawrence Bishnoi gangsters target Bollywood to show who's boss
item.description: Gang violence linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang is resurfacing in Mumbai, targeting celebrities and politicians. Investigations are ongoing into shootings involving actors like Tiger Shroff and Salman Khan. The underworld previously had a notable influence in Bollywood, exerting control through fear and extortion. Comparisons are being drawn to past crime waves spanning several decades. The current trend suggests inexperienced shooters are being used to carry out these attacks.
item.dc:creator: AHMED ALI

item.title: 'Pumped bullet into his head': How row over rent turned deadly for B'luru advocate
item.description: A 42-year-old advocate named B Manjunath was shot dead late on Sunday night in Whitefield. The incident occurred due to a dispute with his tenants, who had not paid rent for three months. Reports indicate that the confrontation escalated when one tenant shot Manjunath from behind while he was counting cash. Police have launched a manhunt for the suspects, who fled on separate motorcycles.
item.dc:creator: RAJIV KALKOD

item.title: Tiger Shroff firing case: Accused lured with cash and promise of settling abroad
item.description: Haryana Police have arrested an associate of Anil Pandit, believed to be the mastermind of the attack. The suspects reportedly received incentives to carry out the shooting and were found operating in Mumbai. Investigators are examining the use of an app for coordinating the incident and identifying additional individuals involved. Previous attempts to shoot a businessman in Amritsar by some accused also came to light during investigations.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.title: 'Jailer 2' box office collection day 5: Rajinikanth's film earns Rs 42.35 cr
item.description: Rajinikanth's film 'Jailer 2' has experienced significant box office collections since its release on October 15, 2026. The film earned Rs 42.35 crore in India net collections on Monday, with a total of Rs 242.25 crore so far. Its overseas collections reached Rs 194 crore after earning Rs 10 crore on the fifth day. Tamil Nadu led in state-wise gross collections, followed by Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.dc:creator: DHANANJAY MAHAPATRA

item.title: 35 years on, FIR against 12 retired cops for ‘fake encounter’ in Kanpur
item.description: Twelve retired policemen are facing an FIR due to a fabricated encounter that took place in 1991. A CB-CID inquiry found that evidence against the arrested men was false and misleading. The inquiry revealed that some men were taken from their homes while asleep and wrongly implicated. Licensed firearms belonging to their families were incorrectly presented as recovered weapons.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Stock market holiday on Dussehra: Are NSE, BSE, MCX open or closed for trading today
item.description: Domestic equity markets including NSE and BSE will remain closed on October 20 for Dussehra. This holiday follows a significant market drop due to weak private banking and disappointing earnings. The Multi Commodity Exchange will operate in the evening despite a morning session closure. Upcoming market holidays for the remainder of 2026 include Diwali Balipratipada and Christmas. Investors should plan their trading activities accordingly during these holidays.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.dc:creator: AYUSH PANDEY

item.title: UK couple turns £380k water tower into £2.75M home
item.description: A Victorian water tower in Kennington, featured in Grand Designs, is listed for £2.75 million. Previously, it sold for £2.5 million after major renovations from an abandoned structure. The owners invested around £2 million in refurbishments and modern additions over two years. Key features include five bedrooms, four bathrooms, and rooftop terrace views of London landmarks. The landmark property is noteworthy for its combination of historical architecture and contemporary interiors.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Texas family sells 650-acre pecan ranch for $10M+ to become state park
item.description: Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation has acquired a 650-acre ranch on Lake Palestine for over $10 million. This land will become a new state park, enhancing public access to natural resources. Initially owned by the Pollard family since 1940, the property has significant natural features and wildlife habitats. The state parks department plans to develop guided tours, campsites, and trails after the 2027 purchase completion.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Meet Padma Shri awardee Anand Kumar: From selling papads to teaching IIT aspirants
item.description: Anand Kumar's odyssey in education began in a humble classroom driven by his love for mathematics. Despite facing significant financial hurdles that hindered his own academic path, he chose to uplift those around him. Thus, he established the Super 30 program aimed at assisting underprivileged students on their journey to IIT.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in

item.title: Jalen Hurts diagnosed with blood clots in lungs: What is pulmonary embolism?
item.description: Jalen Hurts, the quarterback for the Philadelphia Eagles, faces a challenging situation as he is sidelined for the remainder of the 2026 season due to serious health concerns. After an initial diagnosis of a superficial blood clot in his calf, further tests confirmed deep vein thrombosis and clots in his lungs. While undergoing anticoagulant treatment, he will refrain from contact sports.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Deepthi Jeevanji wins 400m T20 gold with Asian Para Games record
item.description: Deepthi Jeevanji won the gold medal in the women's 400m T20 event at the Asian Para Games 2026 after producing a superb performance in the final. Deepthi clocked 56.36 seconds to finish on top of the podium.

item.title: Sheetal Devi creates history, shatters world record at Asian Para Games
item.description: India's para archer Sheetal Devi broke a seven-year-old world record by scoring 149 in the women's compound elimination round at the Asian Para Games 2026. Sheetal surpassed the previous record of 148, set by Jessica Stretton, during her pre-quarterfinal match against Chan Yuen.
item.dc:creator: AMIT KUMAR

item.title: ‘You’ll see soon enough’: Trump on efforts to free US hostage held in Russia
item.description: Donald Trump suggested a potential breakthrough in the release of an American hostage held by Russia. He underscored the necessity of maintaining open communication with Russian President Vladimir Putin on various issues. Trump noted advancements in negotiations concerning the Ukraine conflict, energy supplies, and the hostage situation, while cautioning that he could step back from discussions if they fail to produce results.
item.dc:creator: SUBHADRA SRIVASTAVA

item.title: Sold house, bought Rs 1.10 cr flat with wife; I-T dept rejects exemption for half amount
item.description: A man sold his residential property and invested the proceeds in another flat in Mumbai. The replacement property was jointly registered in his and his wife's names, with the total investment of around Rs 1.10 crore. He claimed exemption on the capital gains under Section 54 of the Income Tax Act.
item.dc:creator: TOI BUSINESS DESK

item.title: Man sees two kids admiring his Lamborghini, what he did next will melt your heart
item.description: Nishant Saboo, a businessman in Hyderabad, noticed two schoolchildren admiring a Lamborghini outside his showroom. He invited the children, Yashvika and Vihaan, inside to see the supercars closely. After their visit, he arranged for a memorable ride in his Lamborghini for them. The children's joy and their father's pride were evident in the video shared online.
item.dc:creator: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK

item.title: Crude holds near $110 per barrel as Middle East tensions keep supply concerns alive
item.description: Currently hovering around $110 a barrel, oil prices are influenced by escalating geopolitical tensions involving Russia and Saudi Arabia. Washington's recent move to relax restrictions on Russian energy exports has shifted market impressions. Attacks claimed by Yemen's Houthis on Saudi facilities have further heightened stability concerns. As a result, prices remain resilient above $100, prompting traders to carefully evaluate the ramifications for global energy security.
item.dc:creator: SHIVANGHI PAYAL

item.title: 1848 Massachusetts mill gets $53M revival as 86 apartments, 69 affordable
item.description: Once a 170-year-old stone mill, the Lawrence, Massachusetts landmark has been revitalized with a $53 million restoration, now offering 86 residential units—69 of them affordable housing options. Among these, 58 are tailored for low-income individuals and 11 designed for those in very low-income brackets. Flood prevention measures include ground floor elevation, and the building incorporates energy-efficient features.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Welsh care deputy took £400k from 99-year-old for surgery, car; struck off
item.description: UK nurse Rebecca Louise Burwood has been struck off the nursing register after an NMC tribunal found she abused her position of trust involving a vulnerable 99-year-old care home resident. More than £370,000 was withdrawn from the woman's account over five years. The hearing also examined spending on a car, motorhome and alleged cosmetic surgery.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Viral: French man forces wife to return looted clothes amid France protests
item.description: A trending video shows a man returning high-end apparel taken by his wife from a store amid protests and looting sweeping across several cities in France. Eyewitnesses are reporting that some families attempted to return stolen items during the upheaval. Reactions to the man's behavior online have been diverse, highlighting themes of personal accountability and contrasting human responses amid chaos.
item.dc:creator: etimes.in
